 The Selma-Dallas County Public Library will host a free Medicare Open Enrollment event on Nov. 24 for those who need assistance. 
 Medicare Open Enrollment ends on Dec. 7. Attendants may review their coverage and make needed changes. 
 The event is being led by the Alabama Department of Senior Services' State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP), in partnership with the Area Agency on Aging. 
 It will be held  9 a.m. – 1 p.m. at the library's location on  1103 Selma Avenue.  
 For more information, contact SHIP Coordinator Sherri Bush at 334-682-5206 or email sherri.bush@atrc.net .
